# GENERATED by tools/chaghatay_culture.py. Do not hand-edit: change the tag
# list or the CHG_IS_CHAGHATAY switch there and re-run it.
#
# The scripted characters of the Chaghatay tags are base setup characters
# (Temür and Taraghai in BRL are khorezmian_culture, the khans in CHG
# mongolian_culture). Once, at game start, every living character of these
# tags who is Mongol or Khorezmian by culture becomes Chaghatay. Dynasties
# are not touched here. Re-declaring on_game_start EXTENDS the mod's other
# start hooks.

on_game_start = {
	on_actions = {
		chaghatay_culture_start
	}
}

chaghatay_culture_start = {
	effect = {
		c:APD ?= {
			every_character = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						culture = culture:mongolian_culture
						culture = culture:khorezmian_culture
					}
				}
				change_character_culture = culture:chaghatay_culture
			}
		}
